_comment: TEMPLATE: copy to project.json inside the project's folder (/data/<collection>/<project>/project.json) and fill in. Keys starting with '_comment' are ignored by the pipeline (JSON has no comment syntax).
_comment_project_names: project_full_name must match the LORIS project name exactly (case-sensitive). The clinical pipeline uses it to correct a mistyped project column, to find the project's candidates, and as the project name in clinical notification emails. project_common_name is the short name used in logs and the other pipelines' emails.
_comment_modalities: Used by the pipeline: list "Imaging" here to enable BIDS import for this project.
_comment_informational: Informational only: not read by the pipeline. Kept for stakeholders and the LORIS project record. To fill a missing site or cohort in the data, use candidate_defaults.
_comment_candidate_defaults: Optional. Fallback values for candidate fields: used only when the data file has no such column or the cell is blank; a value in the file always wins. sex: Male, Female or Other. dob: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY; keep it conservative (e.g. 1970-01-01), never a real date of birth. project: LORIS project name, also used to check which instruments the project can see.
_comment_visit_mappings: Optional (clinical). Maps a visit value in the data (redcap_event_name or Visit_label) to the LORIS visit label. Matching is case-insensitive. Values not listed pass through unchanged, so omit this block when the data already uses the LORIS visit labels.
_comment_sex_mappings: Optional (clinical). Extra sex encodings mapped to Male, Female or Other, added to the built-in M/F/O. Example: {"1": "Male", "2": "Female"}.
_comment_project_mappings: Used by BIDS and DICOM: maps the project label in the data to the LORIS ProjectExternalID.
_comment_participant_metadata: Optional. How the participant metadata pipeline finds participant-level values (e.g. date of death). defaults.bids / defaults.clinical read the data files: identifier_field is the participant id column, identifier_strip_prefix strips 'sub-' from BIDS ids, fields maps a LORIS key to accepted column names. sources lists separate registry CSVs, merged on top. Omit the block if the project has no participant metadata.
_comment_notification_emails: Who is emailed after each run, per modality: on_success for a clean run, on_error for any failure. dicom, bids and participant_metadata send only when enabled is true, and fall back to notification_defaults in loris_client_config.json when a list is missing. clinical ignores enabled and has no fallback: a non-empty list is what sends the email. evidata.on_check_failed receives privacy-check failures (falls back to default_on_evidata_failed).
_comment_evidata: EviData privacy check for THIS project. imaging.enabled and clinical.enabled each switch on their own check (absent or false = off). scan_mode: 'full' dumps every DICOM file, 'sample' one per folder. qis: empty uses the global evidata_config.json list; if that is empty too, every column is a QI minus exclude_qis and minus unique-per-row id columns. qis can be a flat list or a map {'_default': [...], '<file>.csv': [...]}; names are case-sensitive. exclude_qis is case-insensitive and only applies when qis is empty.
